continuity_caveat: Strong Hilbert-space continuity alone is insufficient. Explicit W with endpoint limits supplies uniform continuity and point-norm continuity on the forward-generated algebra.
kernel_check: Representation kernel; explicit full evaluation zero and shifted expectation nonzero. No substitution of vector-null space.
expectation_factorization: pbar(c)=<S,cS>; j(B)-bimodularity holds on the finite-dimensional GNS image.
short_deduction: Invariant kernel would give a continuous finite-dimensional unital endomorphism semigroup. Its bounded generator is a derivation, so expectation of a projection derivative has zero diagonal corners, contradicting T'_0(q)=diag(-1/2,+1/2).
global_positivity_boundary_check: At s=log(2), a_s(-s/2)=-(1/4)q. Global positivity is unnecessary for kernel failure and is a separate property of the candidate's clipped extension.
scope_limits: No claim that BFH explicitly answered the OWR problem
No result on extension after invariant kernel is assumed
No normal von Neumann or weak corner-dilation claim
No continuity claim on full C_b ambient algebra or for every analytic channel
